facts.value: Implements Master Hand's FingerBeam startup and active-loop callbacks, installs a command-gated accessory callback that creates four joint-attached laser items and retains three audio handles, and on loop completion enters FingerBeamEnd, keys off and resets the audio handles, requests laser termination, and clears the fighter-held laser slots. Laser destruction is deferred to the item lifecycle rather than performed directly by this unit.
facts.rationale: Replaces immediate-removal wording with the explicit request-and-clear semantics established by the fighter and item implementations.

evidence.why: Complete startup, loop, resource setup and completion flow.
Termination setter and later animation-side consumption, including reset-before-test ordering.
